verdict.rationale: Meltano docs confirm scheduled pipeline support via Apache Airflow orchestration, allowing recurring job execution, and the CLI supports pipeline management. However, this relies on external orchestration (Airflow) rather than a native built-in scheduler, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of scheduled workflows in production. Missing for 10: native scheduler docs, hands-on community confirmation of recurring job execution, details on failure/retry handling for scheduled runs.
